logger.doc:name: Start MySQL query
logger.message: #["[Sys-Solutech] GET /" ++ (vars.endpoint default "") ++ " started. Database=" ++ (attributes.queryParams.Database default "") ++ " PageNumber=" ++ (attributes.queryParams.PageNumber default "") ++ " Supplier=" ++ (attributes.queryParams.Supplier default "") ++ " fromDate=" ++ (attributes.queryParams.fromDate default "") ++ " toDate=" ++ (attributes.queryParams.toDate default "")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var pageRaw = attributes.queryParams.PageNumber default "" var pageSize = (p("db.page.size") default "10000") as Number --- if (pageRaw as String == "") 0 else ((pageRaw as Number) - 1) * pageSize

%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "SELECT id, product_name FROM " ++ vars.databaseName ++ "." ++ p("db.table.products") ++ " WHERE supplier = :supplier ORDER BY id LIMIT " ++ (vars.pageSize as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.pageOffset as String)

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var db = vars.databaseName var salesTable = p("db.table.sales") var visitsTable = p("db.table.visits") --- "Select a.SHOPID ,a.USERID ,b.routeid ,a.product_id ,a.Supplier_id ,a.SALE_ORDER_ID ,a.Entry_ID ,a.Created_AT ,a.Payment_Status ,a.packaging ,a.quantity ,a.value_sold ,a.Entry_Type from " ++ db ++ "." ++ salesTable ++ " as a left join " ++ db ++ "." ++ visitsTable ++ " as b on a.VisitID =b.visitid where a.Created_AT between :fromTs and :toTs LIMIT " ++ (vars.pageSize as String) ++ " OFFSET " ++ (vars.pageOffset as String)
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { fromTs: (attributes.queryParams.fromDate default "") ++ " 00:00:00", toTs: (attributes.queryParams.toDate default "") ++ " 00:00:00" }

logger.doc:name: Unknown endpoint
logger.message: #["[Sys-Solutech] GET /" ++ (vars.endpoint default "") ++ " has no SQL mapping. Add a when-branch for this endpoint."]

logger.doc:name: Run SQL
logger.message: #["[Sys-Solutech] executing query for /" ++ (vars.endpoint default "") ++ " on Database=" ++ vars.databaseName]
